SELECT u.id AS userId, r.id AS roleId, r.code AS roleCode,
CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(GREATEST(r.update_time, COALESCE(ur.update_time, ur.create_time, r.update_time))) * 1000000 AS UNSIGNED) AS membershipWatermark, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(u.update_time) * 1000000 AS UNSIGNED) AS userWatermark FROM system_users u INNER JOIN system_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted = b'0' INNER JOIN system_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = b'0' WHERE u.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND u.id = #{query.actorUserId} AND u.deleted = b'0' AND u.status = 0 AND r.status = 0 ORDER BY r.id, ur.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT u.id AS userId, r.id AS roleId, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(GREATEST(r.update_time, COALESCE(ur.update_time, ur.create_time, r.update_time))) * 1000000 AS UNSIGNED) AS membershipWatermark, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(u.update_time) * 1000000 AS UNSIGNED) AS userWatermark FROM system_users u INNER JOIN system_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted = b'0' INNER JOIN system_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = b'0' WHERE u.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND u.deleted = b'0' AND u.status = 0 AND r.status = 0 AND r.code = #{query.roleCode} ORDER BY u.id, r.id, ur.id FOR UPDATE
